elements.label: Figure 2.3
elements.title: From adapting standards to aligning and then authoring them
elements.content: Three horizontal phases along a Development trajectory: Adapt -> Align -> Author. Adapt: 'Adapt international standards for the domestic market.' Align: 'Align the domestic market with international standards.' Author: 'Shape international standards with the global community.' A curve representing 'Drive global knowledge' leads from domestic standards up through the phases towards 'Path to higher standards'. Source: WDR 2025 team.
